notes: «قال فذكرت لإبراهيم فحدثني» begins with a first-person speaker who is not named (rule 11), so the second route is written from إبراهيم.
«بمثله سواء» makes the second isnad the same saying (rule 4), so it is a route, not a variant.
«وساق الحديث بنحو حديث أبي الأحوص» names a different transmitter of the same saying: a remark, so it is a variant group (single link, no chain given in the text).
